sn48.41:1.2: Ekam samayam Bhagavā Sāvatthivaṃ viharati Pubbārāme Migāramātupāsāde || || 2.
sn48.41:1.3: Tena kho pana samayena Bhagavā sāyaṇhasamayam paṭisallāṇā vuṭṭhito pacchātape nisinno hoti piṭṭhim otāpayamāno || || 3.
sn48.41:2.1: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā Bhagavato gattāni pāṇinā anomajjanto Bhagavantam etad avoca ||
sn48.41:2.3: na ceva dāni bhante Bhagavato tāva parisuddho chavivaṇṇo pariyodāto sithilāni ca gattāni sabbāni baliyajātāni purato pabbhāro ca kāyo dissati ca indriyānam aññathattaṃ
sn48.41:2.4: cakkhundriyassa sotindriyassa ghānindriyassa jivhindriyassa kāyindriyassā ti || || 4. Evaṃ
sn48.41:3.2: jarādhammo yobbaññe vyādhidhammo ārogye maraṇadhammo jīvite
sn48.41:3.3: na ceva tāva parisuddho hoti chavivaṇṇo pariyodāto sithilāni ca honti gattāni sabbāni baliyajātāni purato pabbhāro ca kāyo || dissati ca indriyānam aññathattaṃ
sn48.41:3.4: cakkhundriyassa sotindriyassa ghānindriyassa || pe || kāyindriyassā ti || || 5.
sn48.41:4.2: idaṃ vatvā ca sugato athāparam etad avoca satthā || ||
